quote: IDB Invest provided a loan package of approximately $368 million to AES Dominicana Renewable Energy S.A. (ADRE), a subsidiary of The AES Corporation in the Dominican Republic, to finance the design, construction and operation of three new non-conventional renewable energy (NCRE) projects totaling 240MWac of installed capacity, and to refinance the short-term debt of three additional renewable energy projects totaling 150MWac of installed capacity. The financing package consists of $37 million from IDB Invest and $331 million mobilized from 21 financial institutions.
note: Opened IDB Invest 22 Nov 2023 (AES ADRE ~USD 368m package).
